verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair question for a state business-filing service, since portals can offer bulk filing or bulk record lookups, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains only robots.txt probes showing bot walls (Akamai 403 and Incapsula interstitials) on www.nvsos.gov and the ORION portal. It says nothing about any bulk-operation capability, so the verdict is none.
